text_simplified: This text speaks about the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and guiding them in the correct ways. It points out that fathers and mothers exert efforts in the tarbiyah of their children, but they may not succeed in reforming them if they do not follow the proper methodology. It emphasizes the necessity of seeking Allah’s assistance in guiding children and directing them toward righteousness.

review_defects.english: may not succeed in reforming them
review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'may not reform them' without the added notion of 'succeed'; the English inserts 'succeed' which implies effort and failure, altering the meaning.
